description: Run a JavaScript expression in an attached page and return its result. Plain objects/arrays come back as JSON (so nested Map/Set/DOM values show as {}); other values (DOM nodes, Map, Set, Error, window) as a short description. Promises are awaited. For multiple statements or await, wrap them: (async () => { ... })(). Runs with the page's full privileges, so it can read cookies/storage and change page state.

target_id.description: Defaults to the most recently attached page

name: evaluate_js
title: Evaluate JavaScript in a page
